title: Card
description: Generic surface container with the shadcn Card's named parts: CardHeader stacks a centred CardTitle (react-aria Heading, level picks the element; display-md, bloom-800) over a centred CardDescription, and CardFooter rows up the actions. Two materials by the material prop (mirrored as data-material): flat (default), the bark-50 sheet with a bark-200 hairline; dotted, the same sheet under a bark-300 dot grid, a stage for a component shown at no particular place. Static surfaces, so both stay flat and separate by border and tint, never by shadow. The glass and dark-glass panes (2026-09-24) were retired on 2026-10-01 with no product consumer; the light pane is the global .glass class for any element (theming §6.2), the dark one stays in the /lab/login-2 archive.

anatomy.description: A div with data-slot="card" and data-material. flat: bark-50 surface, bark-200 hairline border, the house radius. dotted: the flat sheet with a bark-300 dot grid on a 1rem pitch, centred. Accepts any div props and a className to extend.
data-slot="card-header": a column with 0.125rem gap and 0.5rem below, for the title and description.

react-aria Heading with data-slot="card-title": display-md in the display face, weight 700, bloom-800, centred and balanced (text-wrap: balance). `level` picks the element (h2 by default; a card that is the page's main content passes 1).
A p with data-slot="card-description": text-base, bark-700, centred, the muted intro under a title.
data-slot="card-footer": a row of actions with 0.5rem gap; extend it to stack actions.

usage: Compose content inside; Card owns only the surface, border and radius, never padding conventions of its children.

The axis is material, not variant: what the surface is made of (flat, dotted), mirrored as data-material for consumer CSS. A rule that keys on the card's surface selects [data-slot="card"][data-material="dotted"].

Pick the material by placement: flat everywhere a card sits on the sheet or inside the shell's inset, where a card separates by border and tint; dotted only for a stage that shows a component at no particular place (the Components catalogue at /components/buttons), never as a page surface. There is no material for a card on a photograph: the product has no such card since the login's form took the ground (2026-10-01), and the glass and dark-glass panes went with it (theming §4.6). A card on a photograph wears the global .glass class like any other element (theming §6.2).
Prefer extending Card over drawing a bordered box in a route or feature module.
A card's title and intro are CardTitle and CardDescription inside CardHeader; never restate their size or colour in route CSS (theming §1.6).
CardContent is deliberately not ported: Card already pads. Put the body straight inside Card between the header and the footer.
Promotion precedent: a private descendant becomes a top-level component like this one when a second, unrelated component needs it.
